decision.observation: 7 mph, gear 1, all pale dots. The car sits on grass in the notch above the red barn, nose aimed up-frame at the gravel road, which runs across the frame a short distance ahead and then curves up-right into the trees.
decision.hypothesis: Forward motion is building and the road edge is only a couple of car lengths ahead; sustaining plain throttle should push the car up onto the gravel without any steering.
decision.memory: From 0 mph behind the barn, one plain W beat gained 7 mph and closed on the road. The road beyond curves right then left into a pine corridor.
